name: Lula Lucia-Dright
source:
A mysterious, strange maiden who cannot find her place in this World. Lula is the third child of the Lucia family. According to the "Longevity" system, Lula is a High-ranking mtsyr.

[spoiler]Alpha timeline version.[/spoiler]
